Subject: Request to Reschedule Thursday’s Call

Hi [Client Name],

I need to cancel our call scheduled for Thursday due to an unavoidable conflict. I apologize for any inconvenience.

Could we please reschedule? I’m available [insert a few preferred days/times], or feel free to suggest times that work best for you and I’ll do my best to accommodate.

Thanks very much for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

Note: Replace the placeholders ([Client Name], availability, and [Your Name]) before sending.
